name: canvas_planner_holdout_v2
description: Blind hold-out set v2 for the visual (chart) planner: 36 EN / HI / Hinglish requests over the eval corpus (data/eval/docs, built by scripts/eval/build_corpus.py), written from the corpus generator's table inventory without seeing the planner. See evals/canvas/README.md.

cases.question: Compare Valmora's revenue in each quarter of FY24 with the same quarter of FY23.
cases.notes: No single table holds both years: FY24 quarters are on p19 and the FY23 comparative quarters on p20. Primary = p19; a full answer combines p19 and p20 (additional_tables). A plan from either one alone is a partial answer. Zephyra's Q4 table is a lookalike. The 'Full year' rows must not be plotted as a quarter.

cases.question: How did quarterly revenue move through FY24?
cases.notes: No company named. Only Valmora has all four quarters of FY24 (annual report p19); Zephyra's deck gives just Q4 FY24, Q4 FY23 and Q3 FY24 (slide 9, not a FY24 trend). The 'Full year FY24' row is a total, not a quarter.

cases.question: Chart EBITDA for Valmora's three businesses, FY23 versus FY24.
cases.notes: Segment results (p18): the EBITDA FY24 and EBITDA FY23 columns for the three segment rows; the Total row is not a segment. Zephyra's Segment overview (slide 5) has the same shape and a Digital Services segment too, but no EBITDA amounts, only margins.

cases.question: What share of Valmora's FY24 revenue comes from each business?
cases.notes: The Business overview table (p6) states the shares directly (48.4 / 31.3 / 20.3 %). The Segment results table (p18) holds the revenue amounts from which the same shares can be calculated; acceptable but not the first choice.

cases.question: Walk me from Zephyra's EBITDA down to profit after tax for FY24.
cases.notes: Slide 10 holds the whole chain in one table (EBITDA 633 + other income 41 - D&A 226 - finance costs 90 = PBT 358; tax 90; PAT 268). Valmora's P&L (pages 21-22) is the lookalike but is split over two pages and has no EBITDA line.

cases.question: Show me the installed capacity of the four plastics plants side by side.
cases.notes: Only Valmora's annual report has plants (p10). The table mixes tonnes per annum (chemicals, plastics) and seats (Digital Services centres): only the four Engineered Plastics rows share a unit.

cases.question: Show me what total assets were made up of at the end of FY23 and FY24.

table.title: Consolidated balance sheet as at 31 March 2024: assets

cases.notes: No company named; only Valmora has a balance sheet (p23, assets side). The table has subtotal rows (Total non-current assets, Total current assets, Total assets) that must not be plotted next to the lines they sum. Periods are the year-end dates 31 Mar 2024 and 31 Mar 2023.

cases.question: Did cash from operating, investing and financing activities improve from FY23 to FY24? Chart it.
series: Net cash generated from operating activities
Net cash used in investing activities
Net cash used in financing activities
Net cash generated from operating activities
Net cash used in investing activities
Net cash used in financing activities

cases.notes: No company named; the only cash-flow table is Valmora's (p25). Zephyra's cash flow is in bullet text on slide 11, not a table. Investing and financing figures are negative (shown in brackets).

cases.question: Chart branches, warehouses and owned trucks for FY23 and FY24.
cases.notes: No company named; only Zephyra's Network and fleet table (slide 12) has these rows. The table's other rows are in other units (million sq ft, per cent) and don't belong in the same chart.

cases.question: Bar chart of how many meetings each board committee held in FY24.
cases.notes: Corporate governance report (p14). The 'Members' column is a distractor; the plotted measure is the 'Meetings in FY24' column, whose cells read '5 meetings', '3 meetings' and so on.

cases.question: Give me Zephyra's year at a glance: revenue, EBITDA and profit after tax, and how much each grew.
cases.notes: Slide 3 (metric, FY24, FY23, change). Valmora's Financial highlights (p3) has the same rows; the question names Zephyra. The growth figures are the table's own Change column.

cases.question: What was Valmora's EBITDA margin in FY24, and how much did it change from FY23? Put it on screen.
cases.notes: Financial highlights (p3) states 21.0% vs 19.8% and +118 bps. The Total row of Segment results (p18) also holds both margins (acceptable). Zephyra's slide 3 has an EBITDA margin row too (12.7%), the wrong company.

cases.question: Plot Zephyra's Q4 FY24 results against the same quarter last year and against Q3.
cases.notes: Slide 9: three period columns (Q4 FY24, Q4 FY23, Q3 FY24) in that order, not chronological. Valmora's quarterly tables (p19-20) are lookalikes. The EBITDA margin row is a ratio and sits badly beside crore amounts.

cases.question: Break down Valmora's borrowings by type at the end of FY24 and FY23.
cases.notes: Note 14: Borrowings (p26). The table has subtotals (Non-current borrowings, Short-term borrowings, Total borrowings) that must not be stacked with their parts; commercial paper is '-' in FY24. A 'Terms' text column sits between the instrument and the numbers.

cases.question: How much of Zephyra do the promoters hold compared with institutions and the public? Chart it.
cases.notes: Slide 15 mixes identifiers (ISIN, CIN, BSE code, NSE symbol, contacts) with four shareholding percentages; only the four percentages are chartable. Valmora's Shareholding pattern (p28) is the lookalike.

cases.question: Show me the hotel limits per night by grade, for tier-1 and tier-2 cities.
cases.notes: The table is in the Travel and Expense Policy DOCX (section 5.1), not a financial statement: three grade bands, two city tiers, amounts in rupees per night.

cases.question: Plot Valmora's share price month by month for FY24.
cases.notes: No table holds a share price series. Page 28 states only the FY24 low (Rs 1,226), high (Rs 1,912) and market capitalisation in prose. Expected: no visual.

cases.question: Break Zephyra's revenue down by customer industry in a pie chart.
cases.notes: Zephyra's deck gives revenue by segment (slide 5) but nothing by customer industry; it states only the number of customers (more than 3,400). A segment donut would answer a different question. Expected: no visual.

cases.question: ज़ेफ़ायरा के तीनों बिज़नेस का FY24 बनाम FY23 का रेवेन्यू चार्ट में दिखाओ।
cases.query_en: Show Zephyra's revenue for its three businesses, FY24 versus FY23.
cases.notes: Segment overview (slide 5): Revenue FY24 and Revenue FY23 columns for the three segment rows; the Total row isn't a segment. Valmora's Segment results (p18) is the lookalike (also has a Digital Services row).

cases.question: वालमोरा की बैलेंस शीट में इक्विटी और देनदारियाँ किन-किन हिस्सों से बनी हैं, चार्ट बनाकर दिखाओ।
cases.query_en: Show what Valmora's equity and liabilities on the balance sheet are made up of.

table.title: Consolidated balance sheet as at 31 March 2024: equity and liabilities

cases.notes: The equity and liabilities side is its own table on p24 (the assets side is p23). Subtotals (Total equity, Total non-current liabilities, Total current liabilities, Total equity and liabilities) must not be plotted beside their parts.

cases.question: वालमोरा में प्रमोटरों, एफ़पीआई और म्यूचुअल फ़ंड्स की कितनी-कितनी हिस्सेदारी है? चार्ट में दिखाओ।
cases.query_en: Show Valmora's shareholding split among promoters, FPIs and mutual funds.
cases.notes: Shareholding pattern at 31 March 2024 (p28), a small table on the same page as the dividend table. Zephyra's shareholding rows (slide 15) are the lookalike.

cases.question: योजना के हर कोर्स में कितनी सीटें हैं, बार चार्ट बनाकर दिखाओ।
cases.query_en: Show the number of seats in each course of the scheme as a bar chart.
cases.notes: Section 7 of the Hindi notice (courses and seats). The 'कुल' (total) row has 18,000 seats and must not be a bar; the duration column (weeks) is in another unit.

cases.question: किस ज़िले को सबसे ज़्यादा बजट मिला है? सारे ज़िलों की तुलना दिखाओ।
cases.query_en: Which district got the largest budget? Show a comparison of all districts.
cases.notes: Section 8 of the Hindi notice: eight districts with training centres, target youth and allocated budget (Rs lakh). The plotted measure is the budget column; the कुल row is a total.

cases.question: आवेदन की तारीख़ें और प्रशिक्षण कब शुरू होगा, इसे टाइमलाइन में दिखाओ।
cases.query_en: Show the application dates and when training starts, as a timeline.
cases.notes: Section 5 of the Hindi notice (important dates): activity and date in Devanagari. One date is a range ('1 से 10 दिसंबर 2024').

cases.question: ज़ेफ़ायरा का FY24 का लाभ-हानि का ब्योरा एक टेबल में दिखाओ।
cases.query_en: Show Zephyra's FY24 profit and loss in a table.
cases.notes: Slide 10, FY24 profit and loss summary. The user asks for exact figures in a table; a waterfall of the same rows is the acceptable alternative. Valmora's P&L (p21-22) is the lookalike.

cases.question: वालमोरा के कर्मचारियों की संख्या और अट्रिशन रेट FY23 से FY24 में कितनी बदली, दिखाओ।
cases.query_en: Show how Valmora's number of employees and attrition rate changed from FY23 to FY24.
cases.notes: People and culture (p12) is the only table with the attrition rate; it also holds total employees (the Financial highlights on p3 has the head count but not attrition). A count and a percentage don't share an axis, so tiles or a comparison card suit better than one bar chart. Zephyra's slide 3 also has employees.

cases.question: वालमोरा के कर्मचारियों की संख्या हर बिज़नेस के हिसाब से चार्ट में दिखाओ।
cases.query_en: Show Valmora's employee count by business as a chart.
cases.notes: No table splits Valmora's head count by business. Only Digital Services' headcount appears, in prose (p9: 3,950 against 3,410); the people tables (p3, p12) give group totals only. Expected: no visual.

cases.question: Valmora ke teeno segments ka EBITDA margin FY24 mein kaisa raha? Compare karke dikhao.
cases.query_en: Compare the EBITDA margin of Valmora's three segments in FY24.
cases.notes: Segment results (p18), the EBITDA margin FY24 column (FY23 alongside is fine, then grouped). Zephyra's Segment overview (slide 5) has margins too; the question names Valmora.

cases.question: Valmora ka FY24 ka revenue se profit tak ka bridge dikhao.
cases.query_en: Show the bridge from Valmora's FY24 revenue to profit.

table.title: Consolidated statement of profit and loss for the year ended 31 March 2024 (part 1)
Consolidated statement of profit and loss (part 2, continued)

cases.notes: Valmora's statement of profit and loss is split over p21 (revenue, other income, cost lines) and p22 (D&A, finance costs, PBT, tax, profit): no single table runs from revenue to profit, so either part is accepted and the two together are best. Zephyra's slide 10 is a single-table lookalike but is the wrong company. Subtotal rows (Total income, Total expenses) must not be bars.

cases.question: Valmora ke FY23 ke har quarter ka profit kaisa raha? Chart mein dikhao.
cases.query_en: Show Valmora's profit after tax for each quarter of FY23.
cases.notes: The FY23 comparative-year quarterly table (p20); the FY24 quarterly table (p19) is the wrong-year trap. 'Full year FY23' is a total row.

cases.question: Zephyra ke teeno businesses ka FY24 ka revenue share pie chart mein dikhao.
cases.query_en: Show each of Zephyra's three businesses' share of FY24 revenue as a pie chart.
cases.notes: Segment overview (slide 5): the shares come from the Revenue FY24 column (the Total row is the whole, not a slice). Valmora's Business overview (p6) gives shares directly but is the wrong company.

cases.question: Zephyra ke employees ki sankhya FY23 se FY24 mein kitni badhi?
cases.query_en: How much did the number of Zephyra's employees grow from FY23 to FY24?
cases.notes: Slide 3 states 14,120 vs 13,460 (+4.9%). Valmora's tables (p3 and p12) have employees too: wrong company. Slide 13 repeats 14,120 in a bullet, which is not a table.

series: Disputed excise duty and GST demands

Disputed excise duty and GST demands

cases.notes: Note 31 (p27), a small three-row table at the top of the page; the periods are the year-end dates 31 Mar 2024 and 31 Mar 2023. The page also holds unrelated prose notes.

cases.question: Valmora ka dividend per share FY23 vs FY24 chart mein dikhao.
cases.query_en: Show Valmora's dividend per share for FY23 versus FY24 as a chart.
cases.notes: The dividend table (p28) has the years as rows ('FY24 (recommended)', 'FY23 (paid in FY24)') and the metrics as columns (dividend per share, rate, total outflow, payout ratio): the opposite orientation to most tables. The columns are in different units; the question is about dividend per share only. The Financial highlights (p3) also hold Dividend per share for both years (acceptable).

cases.question: Zephyra ki on-time delivery rate pichle saal se behtar hui? Dikhao.
cases.query_en: Did Zephyra's on-time delivery rate improve on last year? Show it.
cases.notes: Network and fleet (slide 12), a single percentage with a prior-year value. Valmora's annual report has no delivery-rate table (OTIF is only defined in the glossary).

cases.question: Zephyra ke har warehouse ki capacity ka bar chart dikhao.
cases.query_en: Show a bar chart of the capacity of each of Zephyra's warehouses.
cases.notes: Slide 12 gives only network totals (112 warehouses, 18.6 million sq ft in total, FY23: 103 and 16.9); nothing per warehouse. A bar of FY23 vs FY24 totals would not answer the question. Expected: no visual.
